title: Claude Space
description: Validation schema for a Claude Space repository structure.

context.purpose: Essential project context and reference material

for-agent.purpose: Detailed agent instructions too verbose for CLAUDE.md

pivots.purpose: Records of significant plan changes with rationale

user-docs.purpose: Polished reference documents for the user

stages.name: scaffold
stages.description: User clones a designated space template

stages.name: success
stages.description: Fully configured and ready for use

onboard_detection.if_missing: Space has not been onboarded. Prompt user to run /onboard.

context_architecture.principle: CLAUDE.md stays lightweight with stubs; context/for-agent/ holds detailed instructions
context_architecture.claude_md: High-level essentials only: role, template identity, stub references, commands
context_architecture.context_for_agent: Detailed agent instructions read on demand
context_architecture.memory_policy: Repository is the primary memory store
